name: DualView Plugin
description: DualView — pre/post-tool hooks for trust classification and taint tracking. Trusted results remain agent-visible as raw output; untrusted results are symbolized.

auditTrail.description: Enable audit trail: write a JSONL entry to ~/.openclaw/logs/dualview-audit/<sessionKey>.jsonl for every hook modification. Useful for anomaly detection and session forensics.

labelMode.description: Which tool result classes to process for agent-visible taint marking. Trusted results are classified/audited but are not text-prefixed. 'untrusted_only' only marks untrusted content. 'none' disables result labeling (pre-tool hook still runs).

verbose.description: Print DualView-[purpose:hook] lines to stdout for every tool call.

botToken.description: Slack bot token for posting hook notifications (optional, legacy from v0.1)

targetChannels.description: Channel IDs to enable DualView hooks for (prefixed, e.g. 'discord:1234567890'). Use 'platform:*' wildcard to match all channels for a platform (e.g. 'telegram:*').

disabledTargetChannels.description: Channel IDs to disable DualView hooks for even when targetChannels includes a broad wildcard such as 'slack:*'. Supports prefixed channel IDs (e.g. 'slack:C0123456789') and platform wildcards (e.g. 'slack:*').

targetSessionIds.description: Session key fragments to enable DualView hooks for (e.g. phone numbers for CLI agent runs)

disabledTargetSessionIds.description: Session key fragments to disable DualView hooks for. Disabled entries take precedence over targetSessionIds and targetChannels.

notifyChannel.description: Where to post DualView-[purpose:hook] notifications. Supports 'slack:ID', 'discord:ID', or 'file:/path/to/file.jsonl'

taintMode.description: How to mark untrusted values. Only 'symbolize' is supported (replaces values with opaque symbols); the legacy 'inline' mode was removed in #234.

toolSchemas.description: DEPRECATED — prefer Data Trust Policy `tools.<name>.inbound` in dualview-policy.yaml (issue #210). User overrides for per-tool output field schemas (merged with built-in schemas). Still read for back-compat.

toolInputResolve.description: DEPRECATED — prefer Data Trust Policy `tools.<name>.outbound` in dualview-policy.yaml (issue #210). User overrides for per-tool input symbol resolution (merged with built-in TOOL_INPUT_RESOLVE). Set tool name to true (resolve symbols) or false (keep symbols). Still read for back-compat.

inboundDefault.description: Trust classification applied to tool results when no inbound spec matches the tool. 'TRUSTED' (default) passes results through unmodified — fail-open, legacy behavior. 'UNTRUSTED' blanket-symbolizes the entire result — fail-closed, safer for deployments that add new tools without yet declaring their inbound spec.

execInboundDefault.description: Fallback trust classification for `exec` output when no per-command spec matches. Restricted exec (`env.RESTRICTED=1`) is trusted.

outboundDefault.description: Symbol resolution applied to tool params when no outbound spec matches the tool. 'resolve' (default) replaces symbols with raw values before the tool runs — lets new tools work without an explicit spec, at the cost of letting untrusted values flow into the tool. 'not_resolve' keeps symbols opaque — fail-closed, prevents symbolized values from leaking into tools that may egress them, but an unspec'd tool that cannot interpret symbols will see literal '$_DUALVIEW_SYM_*' strings.

fileTrackingEnabled.description: Enable git-based file tracking. After each tool call, file changes are committed with trust tags ([DUALVIEW-TRUSTED]/[DUALVIEW-UNTRUSTED]). Requires the agent workspace to be a git repo.

fileTrackingGitRoot.description: Git root for file tracking. Defaults to auto-detected git root from cwd (typically .openclaw/workspace/). Required for bot deployments where cwd is not inside a git repo. Supports ~/ tilde expansion.

fileTrackingStrategy.description: How to determine tracked git roots. 'fixed' uses one configured root; 'ondemand' creates canonical DualView roots dynamically.

inspectModel.description: Model to use for the untrusted LLM in inspect_symbol (for example, 'openai-codex/gpt-5.4' or 'openai/gpt-5.4-mini').

inspectTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for each inspect_symbol untrusted LLM invocation before returning a timeout error.

inspectMissingFields.description: How to handle missing outputSchema fields in inspect_symbol responses. 'strict' omits missing fields and returns structured warnings. 'skip' omits missing fields from result. 'null' includes missing fields with null-symbol sentinels.

scalarTaintMode.description: How to handle non-string scalar types (int, float, bool) in inspect_symbol output. 'symbolize' (default) re-symbolizes all values. 'inline' returns scalar values as-is (trusted inline metadata).

policyPath.description: Path to dualview-policy.yaml for the persistent Data Trust Policy (URL, CHANNEL, DIR category policy and per-tool inbound/outbound overrides).

inspectSubagent.description: Subagent id to host the untrusted LLM (`inspect_symbol` tool). Defaults to a built-in subagent.

fixtureUrlMap.description: URL → fixture mapping for offline web_fetch / web_search testing. Keys are URLs, values describe canned response payloads.

humanEditPolicy.description: How to handle manual human edits in the human-view worktree. 'auto' (default) detects and reconciles human edits before each tool call. 'explicit' only reconciles when triggered by the user. 'ignore' disables human-edit detection entirely.

webhookSchemas.description: Per-webhook trust schemas, keyed by jobName. Each value maps field names to 'TRUSTED' or 'UNTRUSTED'. Fields not listed default to UNTRUSTED. Supports three payload formats: (1) template+data: webhook sends { "template": "...", "data": {...} } — template is rendered with per-field symbolized data; (2) flat JSON: webhook sends a plain JSON object — fields are symbolized in-place; (3) non-JSON: entire content is symbolized as a single opaque variable.
